item.title: Origins and Stabilization of Economic Cycles
item.content:encoded:
This special issue honors Kazuo Nishimura's contributions to economic research by bringing together work on the fundamental causes of economic cycles and approaches to managing their effects. The issue seeks papers that advance understanding of both how economic cycles originate and the mechanisms through which they can be stabilized.

Appel publié par Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Economic cycle theory and modeling
  • Stabilization policies and mechanisms
  • Macroeconomic dynamics
  • Business cycle analysis
  • Policy responses to cyclical fluctuations
